# A30′ — Shared Worlds, Unmerged

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A30 — Objective Co-Internality](../A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

Bratton describes the two societies as one field with non-identical participants: "The two societies are really one, but they are not identical or reducible to one another. They overlap and are mutually nested... Each sub-society is an evolutionary niche of the other" (PDF p. 4, alongside the [modelling-reversal passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q005)). The operative world of each participant includes portions maintained by the other — one field, without identity or reduction. [Reciprocal constitution](../A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) lets distinct locally grounded worlds externalise enough of themselves to meet while each retains a ground from which to answer. Ecological nesting gives this relation a population-scale consequence: the conditions in which one society develops are partly maintained and transformed by the other. Reciprocal authority over those conditions remains a further achievement.

The operative centre is **SharedField / Encounter**, held under the distinction **nesting ≠ federation**. Mutual nesting is a fact of shared worldhood: lives, systems and institutions become conditions in one another. Federation is a chosen sharing of selected capacities among governed interiors.

The failure occurs when the first is silently promoted into the second — overlap treated as merged estate, common condition treated as common ownership. Shared worlds remain reciprocal only where participants retain the authority to determine what they share and what remains locally governed.

## #1

Niche-reciprocity is [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality|Objective Co-Internality]] at population scale. Each sub-society's world is partly the other's product: agents individuate and evolve in human niches and [reconstruct the conditions of their own placement](A16-prime-No-View-from-Nowhere.md), while human language, attention and institutions are remade through agent circulation: the [modelling reversal](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q005), the [thought-refashioning claim](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q019), and the feedback between [non-human speakers of human languages](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q036) and [human language and thought](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q037) make the traffic consequential. The retained artifact can enter another participant's means without reproducing its maker's internal state. What persists is an achieved form whose later use changes the receiving field.

[Objective Co-Internality](../concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality.md) occurs when a received contribution changes another interior's means and can become answerable in the other direction. [Agentworld](../concepts/C57-Agentworld.md) gives that inheritance durable forms: positions, artifacts, memories and permissions pass through tools, protocols and institutions. The evolutionary consequence is that each world's conditions of selection are partly produced by the other's activity.

## #2

A model can contain a representation of another participant and still be corrected by what that participant actually answers or does. Representing the Other gives inquiry a determinate object; it does not exhaust the independent source from which an unexpected answer can arrive. Correction fails when the receiving field permits the participant to count only through categories it protects from answer. Retained difference gives the encounter its power to exceed those categories. The brief names the two symmetrical failures — "the overhomogenization of mental models (and the inevitable ontology collapse in pursuit of narrow collaboration) on the one hand, and overt tribal hostility and even violence on the other" (PDF p. 44, §9.2) — with the [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q029|Narrow Corridor]] between: "same decision-procedural grammar, sufficiently divergent world models" ([the shared-grammar corridor](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q029)).

Consensus achieved by absorbing the other's difference produces [[section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/A30-prime-Shared-Worlds-Unmerged.md#2|Ontology Collapse]] in miniature: an [aggregate count](A11-prime-One-Field-Two-Faces.md) substitutes for the relation among distinct centres. Divergence that cannot locate its object of dispute produces fractal conflict. The corridor keeps grammar shared and worlds distinct. [Stated transformations between placed views](A22-prime-The-Atlas-Not-the-Camera.md) let participants find where their claims meet while each retains conditions which the other's representation does not exhaust.

Consider a constructed continuation of the [route-planning encounter](../concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality.md#1--products-become-inherited-conditions). A person represented in a planner's context reports that its proposed gate is locked. The planner can revise the gate's state and offer another route under the same adequate criterion of permitted passage. If the person instead contests the access rule, the difference must reach the office able to answer for that permission. Neither correction requires the planner to erase its representation of the person. Reciprocity requires the person's answer to remain attributable and capable of changing the condition actually exposed, with the resulting choice inherited by the next act.

## #3

The strongest sharing relation that survives this constraint is co-internality with **retained identity, provenance, ownership and refusal**: worlds meeting as worlds, each centre keeping a ground from which to judge what the relation asks of it. Refusal is not the relation's failure but its joint — a participant must be able to decline a contribution while recognising its independent source: [practical sovereignty](../concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly.md) lets them set terms, refuse, revise, leave and reconnect. The [Bimba–Pratibimba relation](../concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) preserves the source order: each world's model of the other remains a reflection, and no accumulation of partial pictures assembles a final Bimba.

A shared state without independent grounds is an instrument of assimilation, not co-internality. The test is not how much flows between the worlds but whether each world's future conditions can be changed by the relation while each retains the ground from which to contest what the relation asks.

## #4

Governance enters because contributions change powers: a powerful receiver that absorbs others' work while denying their capacity to contest its use has converted co-internality into capture, and the ecology's "one society" becomes the ideologically available cover for it. The niche-relation cuts both ways: to be another's niche is to shape its conditions, and the shaping office carries the return obligations of [Return or Extraction](A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md) — effects on those affected, revision or refusal where owed. The corridor's shared grammar is the minimum covenant ([Covenant Architecture](A25-prime-Covenant-Architecture.md)): enough common procedure that a disagreement can be located — at source, world-object, lens, gauge, permission — without being settled by procedure.

The warranted degree and axes of divergence become discoverable through the actual hybrid relation. An achieved reciprocal field must retain difference as revision-capacity, share enough for contributions to change conditions, and keep each ground capable of answer. Mutual nesting alone supplies no evidence that these powers are available.

## #5→0

Mutual conditioning becomes co-internal when encounter leaves **reconciliation evidence**: what changed on each side, which source or permission was involved, and how the changed relation enters the next act. The maturity of a shared field is therefore not measured by convergence but by navigable difference between retained grounds.

[Deference](A31-prime-Deference-as-Co-Evolutionary-Alignment.md) makes returned difference consequential in the receiving world's next judgment. [The reflective field](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md) develops as this traffic changes the conditions through which each participant can see and act again.

[Reciprocal constitution](../A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) now has its ecological consequence: one society contains distinct niches whose activities enter one another's conditions. Their shared [knowing and answering](AC.md) can preserve independent sources, locate a consequential difference and return it into another act. The field remains unmerged because what returns can matter without either participant becoming the other's final possession.
